## Pins instead of hearts

- Favorites now use a **pin** icon. A filled pin means the command is pinned, an outlined pin
  means it is not.
- The **Favorite** tab is now the first tab in the Command screen.
- **A fresh install starts with five pinned commands**: Wi-Fi, Dark theme, Show layout bounds,
  Pointer position and Show taps. Unpin any of them and they stay unpinned. If you already use
  the app but never pinned anything, you get the same five once.

## Command tabs fit without scrolling

- The category tabs are smaller and closer together.
- When the window is too narrow for all the labels, only the selected tab shows its label. The
  other tabs show their icon, and the name appears when you hover over them.

## Updating

On Windows, use the **Update now** banner or Settings > Updates (from 1.6.2 on). On Linux the
banner opens this page. Versions before 1.6.2 must be updated by hand once.
